relationship: Selecting a source, sample rate and bit depth connects a waveform representation to digital sound quality and storage.

learnerLoop.action: Choose a sound, adjust rate, depth and smoothing, then play or inspect it.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The sampled representation and playback selection change.
learnerLoop.evidence: The waveform, samples, bit count, status and reference/digital playback expose the effect.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Compare another sampling choice and explain the quality or data trade-off.

invariants: The displayed samples and storage figures follow the active sound and sampling settings.
Reference and digital playback remain distinguishable for comparison.
safeAdaptations: Change sound examples, guidance or comparison prompts while retaining controllable sampling and evidence.
nonGoals: Acting as a full audio editor or exporting sound files.

task.description: Goal above the sound-selection menu and Reference/Digital/Stop controls.
task.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

model.description: Reference waveform, quantised reconstruction and selected timeline window.
model.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

settings.description: Sample rate, resolution, optional reconstruction smoothing and view zoom.
settings.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

evidence.description: Rate/storage equation, quantisation levels, taller uncropped stored-sample area and hover details.
evidence.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

rate.output: Reconstructed waveform, Nyquist note and storage equation.

depth.description: Bits used to represent each sample.
depth.domain: Selectable resolution from 2 to 16 bits; 2^bits amplitude levels.

storage.description: Raw mono PCM bit rate and data size.
storage.domain: rate × bits per second; sample count × bits / 8 bytes.
storage.source: Selected recording, sampling rate and resolution.

window.source: Overview drag/arrow keys, earlier/later and zoom buttons.

modes.recording: Ocean, bird and human speech are embedded PCM recordings.
modes.reconstruction: Default held samples; optional linear interpolation and low-pass smoothing.
modes.support: Open comparison with no Working, exam or scored completion control.

dependencies: Changing recording or sampling settings regenerates quantised samples and storage calculations.
Playback chooses reference or reconstructed data; Stop ends playback.
Timeline and zoom change the view without altering sampling parameters.
implementation.completion: No terminal gate; learners compare representations, values, cost and audio, then change settings.
limitations: Raw mono PCM size excludes file headers and compression.
Playback requires browser audio support; source recordings remain embedded for offline use.
